newsitem.title: USA: Regions Financial to buy First Mercantile.
newsitem.headline: Regions Financial to buy First Mercantile.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said it will buy First Mercantile National Bank of Longwood, Fla., for $30 a share in cash, or about $21 million.
Regions said First Mercantile had $144.6 million in assets an November 30 and $82.2 million in loans.
Regions officials were not immediately available to comment.

The transcation is expected to close in the second quarter of 1997, Regions said. After it, G. Geoffrey Longstaff -- president and chief executive of First Mercantile -- will become the new bank's president.
